@title PlatformLedger
 @notice Centralized RMB ledger (amounts in fen: 1 RMB = 100 fen).
         Passwords stay off-chain; contract only stores balances by userId / wallet.
 Dual roles (set in constructor, transferable):
 - operator: depositByAdmin, consume, setRate, pause/unpause, role transfer
 - withdrawer: only withdrawToken / withdrawUSDT (cannot credit/debit/rate)
 USDT deposit math (rateScaled = 660 means 6.60 RMB per 1 whole USDT):
   rmbFen = usdtAmount * rateScaled / (10 ** usdtDecimals)
 Example (6 decimals USDT, rateScaled=660): 1_000_000 * 660 / 1e6 = 660 fen = 6.60 RMB
 Example (18 decimals BSC USDT): 1e18 * 660 / 1e18 = 660 fen = 6.60 RMB
@notice RMB fen per 1 whole USDT, scaled by 100. Default 660 => 6.60 RMB/USDT.
@notice Backend account hash (e.g. keccak256 of username) => balance in fen
@notice Wallet users (USDT depositors) => balance in fen
@notice Prevents duplicate deposit/consume by order id
@notice Credit fen after off-chain payment callback (e.g. Alipay). orderId must be unique.
@notice Debit fen for consumption. Reverts if balance insufficient. orderId must be unique.
@notice Set exchange rate. rateScaled=660 means 6.60 RMB per 1 whole USDT.
@notice Convenience wrapper for withdrawing the configured USDT.
